title: How does Houston plan without zoning?
summary: City Beautiful explains how Houston, which has no formal zoning, still shapes land use through deed restrictions, parking minimums and buffering ordinances.
why: HN uses it as the standard primer for the point that Houston's 'no zoning' is a misconception, since its rules produce similar effects.

quote.text: Giving you a link to City Beautiful which works as a great primer.
